ops.loadingHours: The 1F floor plan in the guide PDF shows the load-in/load-out entrance and route, the underground parking entrance and the outdoor parking entrance (June 2024 edition). (Source: Banquet guide PDF)
ops.parking: The parking lot holds 154 vehicles. Hotel parking cannot be reserved; if it is full, guests are directed to nearby public parking lots. General parking is 600 yen for the first hour, then 300 yen per 30 minutes. Banquet use is free for up to 3 hours 30 minutes (up to 6 hours for weddings); exhibition use is charged. Under the parking lot regulations, vehicles up to 5.0 m long, 1.9 m wide, 2.1 m high and 2.5 t in weight can enter (larger vehicles are possible in the outdoor parking lot if notified in advance); it is open from 0:00 to 24:00, 365 days a year (last revised June 28, 2024). (Source: Facilities page)
ops.waitingRooms: Shiun and Hakuun on the 5F are VIP waiting rooms with a total floor area of 40㎡ (12 tsubo). (Source: Shiun/Hakuun page)
ops.catering: Bringing in food and drinks to serve to attendees is prohibited (unless permitted by the hotel). Decorations, entertainment, costumes, gifts, flowers, photography and the like must use companies designated by the hotel; if a non-designated company is used, preparation and bring-in fees must be discussed with the hotel in advance (Banquet Hall Terms of Use, last revised November 1, 2025). The hotel's catering accepts from 5 to over 1,000 guests: standing plan 7,260 yen per person (from 30 guests; catering fee charged separately), Shokado bento + serving staff 9,680 yen per person (from 10 guests), Western course meal + serving staff 12,100 yen per person (from 10 guests), Makunouchi bento delivery 6,050 yen per person (from 10 guests; delivery fee of 5,500 yen charged separately). All prices include service charge and tax. Excluded dates are December 29, 2026 to January 11, 2027. (Source: Banquet Terms of Use PDF, Catering page)
ops.restaurants: The hotel's restaurants are Japanese Cuisine Miyama (日本料理〈みやま〉), Sushi Restaurant Yaichi (鮨処〈八一〉) and Teppan-yaki Yamanami (鉄板焼〈やまなみ〉) on the 15F, and Chinese restaurant Nan-en (中国料理〈南園〉) and Restaurant Le clair (レストラン〈ル クレール〉) on the 2F. The lounges are SOTO BAR on the 2F and the Lobby Lounge on the 1F. (Source: Restaurant page)
